events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, was born on this day in Dartford, Kent, in 1943.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! We're celebrating the one and only Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, made its debut on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video aired.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-five years since MTV changed the game. Remember watching 'Video Killed The Radio Star' for the very first time?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' celebrates 31 years
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-one years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. What's the track that still gives you that 'Madchester' vibe?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music' in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since Woodstock. A moment that defined a generation. Which iconic performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years on
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977 at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Elvis' Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost The King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define rock and roll. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' celebrates 57 years
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring hits like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' gave us that iconic zebra crossing shot. Still one of the greatest album covers ever?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, was born on this day in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The outspoken former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, was born on this day in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Fifty-four years of pure rock and roll swagger! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in October 1975, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod celebrates 24 years
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod's Impact
angles.copy: Twenty-four years since the original iPod dropped. Remember your first one? It certainly changed the way we carried our music!

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to crack open a shaken-not-stirred martini and debate your favourite Bond, film, and theme tune. Go!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, was born on this day in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite of his moments?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' celebrates 58 years
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track from the double LP?
